data.body: Triage close (orphan cleanup 2026-06-02): SUPERSEDED / won't-do. This task removed the local review gates (pre-commit-review-gate.sh, review-gate.sh, bypass sentinel). Its parent story 5428-bebd ('commit without local enforcement gates') was DELETED and parent epic 1083-fb3d (local workflow simplification) is CLOSED without performing the removal. The gates remain present and are load-bearing under current CLAUDE.md rules (rule:fabrication, rule:no-bypass-review). Performing this removal now would weaken active safeguards (rule:no-safeguard-edits). Closing as obsolete; reopen only if the ci-pr local-gate-removal effort is revived.
